g.text: SolderShape Q1 | millimeters | QUOTE STAGE | vendor interfaces UNRELEASED
Joint stays horizontal in both index configurations. Vendor sensor head is intentionally absent.
Upper load path: island, cap, conformal bond, silica stalk, cool bond/tab, approved sensor tip.
Do not add a guide, temperature wire or shield contact to the moving carrier.
Base 80 x 80 x 8. Internal mounting clearance holes diameter 4.5 on a 60 x 60 square.
Sensor mating, stage, heater, chamber and all bond/process interfaces remain unreleased.
Source model.py + spec.json. Linear dimensions govern. Do not scale this drawing.
